description: What an organiser may read about each guest, per admission policy (#2493, FIX-19; owner decisions OQ-1 and OQ-2). Every organiser sees the guest's card (name, first photo, city) and the roster facts of their own event. organiserFields are the extra guest fields the policy itself needs; the server writes them to eventGuestDisclosures/{eventId}__{uid} when the guest books, joins the waitlist or asks to join. grantFields are profile answers the guest may later choose to share for admission, as a grant with an expiry (a later #2493 step; none is written yet). A guest's orientation (booking cohort) is never an organiser field. disclosure is the line the guest sees when they book or ask to join; the owner approved these lines, the 7-day retention after the event and that orientation is never shown (26 Nov 2026).
